The Far Left is on the rise.

“The number of incoming college students who describe their political beliefs as “far left” has tripled since the early 1980s, and doubled since 2013.

The number of far-left Gen Z college students even exceeds the number among the Boomers of the early 1970s.” — @robkhenderson
